request.prompt: Input 1 is the current Buki mobile app screen. Input 2 is the Buki golden bear reading a coral book brand icon. Redesign the whole screen as a polished buildable mobile UI concept for a modern kids drawing scrapbook. Keep the basic structure: warm background, compact Buki wordmark and sketchpad selector at top, centered sketchpad, floating camera button at bottom. Create a portrait one-page sketchpad with a clearly visible modular dot grid, generous artwork-safe margins, rounded paper, top ring binding, playful corner tabs, and subtle tactile paper depth. Sunshine Studio palette: warm ivory #FFF7E8, lively coral #FF7A59, lemon #FFD84D, fresh turquoise #48C6B7, calm blue #4A79D8, dark ink #25364A. Make it modern, cheerful, premium, child-friendly, uncluttered, and realistic to implement in Expo and Skia. Use the bear icon only as brand mood; a tiny paw or bear stamp is optional. No device frame, no extra copy, no gibberish text, no photorealistic room.
